independent_seed_check.result: All six root case seeds matched exactly, including both exchanges, ownership production and all8 boundary-admissible midpoint labelings.

case_scope_refinement: W1/W2 Cobb-Douglas preferences are weakly monotone on the full orthant and strictly monotone only away from axes. Their equilibria are established directly, including zero-price nonattainment, not by incorrectly invoking the stronger global strict-coordinate theorem. W5 Leontief is also explicitly weakly monotone. The linear W5 example satisfies the main preference hypotheses.

proof_contracts.title: Economic definitions and Walras accounting
proof_contracts.route: State finite households/firms, net supplies, ownership shares summing to1, incomes and exact market clearing. Distinguish weak budget inequality from equality after exhaustion; positive price scaling normalizes without altering choices.

proof_contracts.title: Finite-dimensional Sperner with fine triangulations
proof_contracts.route: Define compatible triangulations and facet incidences. Prove barycentric subdivision coverage/intersections using ordered barycentric coordinates and coefficients k(lambda_k-lambda_(k+1)); nested-face barycentres give mesh contraction d/(d+1). Induct on dimension using marked facets0..d-1 and interior2/boundary1 parity.

proof_contracts.title: Brouwer plus compact-convex extension
proof_contracts.route: Use strict coordinate deficits, stop at an exact fixed vertex, and take a compact subsequence of fully labeled cells with vanishing mesh. Prove nearest-point projection uniqueness, variational inequalities and nonexpansiveness, then extend through a containing simplex.

proof_contracts.title: Kakutani
proof_contracts.route: Prove compact-range closed graph implies open-neighborhood UHC and its converse with closed values. Finite epsilon/2 nets and tent weights give continuous approximate selections; Brouwer fixed points converge, all active selected values are close to F(limit), convexity/closedness finish.

proof_contracts.title: Sufficient compact-generator economic existence
proof_contracts.route: Continuous convex strictly coordinate-monotone orthant preferences, individual positive endowments, compact convex K_j containing0 and full disposal. Continuous positive profit incomes, common cap above aggregate resource upper bounds, budget approximation by strict cheaper zero, maximizing comparisons and closed graphs. Apply Kakutani to price/household/firm product. Auction and accounting give z<=0; zero prices contradict cap/resources; cap interior gives exhaustion and exact clearing.

proof_contracts.title: Remove the cap and delimit claims
proof_contracts.route: Globally preferred affordable bundle remains preferred after a slight radial shrink and becomes strictly cheaper. Small mixture with cap-interior allocation is weakly preferred under convexity; a small coordinate increase makes a strictly preferred capped affordable bundle. Firms already maximize over full disposal technology. No universal production, uniqueness or convergence claim.
